C.1
text: 1. **An ordered build sequence** across the five core components and sixteen capabilities. Separate real dependencies from apparent ones.

name: C.2
text: 2. **A first-cut design for Dispatch and State** (B5). If you searched for prior art and found none, say what you searched.

name: C.3
text: 3. **Per piece: a machine-checkable definition of done, plus the deliberate breakage that proves the check can fail.** A criterion nothing can fail is not a criterion.

name: C.4
text: 4. **A second adapter for at least three capabilities**, chosen to prove the interface is not shaped around its current implementation. Design rule 3.

name: C.5
text: 5. **What you could not decide, and what evidence would decide it.** A required output, not an apology.

name: C-constraint-203
text: - In Part B output, **name capabilities and standards, never products.** Products belong in the adapter column only.

name: C-constraint-204
text: - Prefer an existing standard to an original design. Cite the standard and its version.

name: C-constraint-205
text: - Part A is substrate, not scope. Do not propose replacing what runs.
